question: On locally-hosted 6-state correlated FSM construction (L per trajectory 50x40 steps, basin bias 0.70/0.30, DOM_before SHA256(L||state||variant%3) 36 hashes |R|/N 0.018, independent-noise control falsified at BC 0.004 bits), with Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial recalibrated to K=24 (alpha=1/K) or N~4000 and trajectory-grouped permutation 1000 perms seed 42, does trajectory-grouped CMI achieve valid null centering (|null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01) with BC>0.05 p_bonf<0.01 and gap >=0.05 over B-DOM-SIMILARITY and B-MARKOV-1 on R1 visible_text_hash or R2 a11y_tree_hash while independent-noise replication remains BC~0 (|BC|<0.05 p>0.10 null_std>0.01), without requiring new Gate0 production SPAs?
hypothesis: On locally-hosted Express SPAs with correlated-state non-determinism where latent regime L (session/permission/user-data, persistent per trajectory 50 trajectories x40 steps =2000 transitions N=1999 analyzed, basin bias 0.70/0.30 favoring {0,1,2} vs {3,4,5}) jointly determines S_next and DOM_before via DOM_before=SHA256(L||state||variant%3) (36 unique hashes, |R|/N 0.018, dom_bytes 24, a11y_bytes 24, leakage 0.0, MI(DOM;Action) 0.0), conditional CMI I(S_next; DOM_before | URL, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) measured with Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial recalibrated to K=24 alpha=1/K N=1999 seed 42 trajectory-grouped permutation 1000 perms seed 42 is >0.05 bits with p_bonf<0.01 (Bonferroni over R1/R2 x primary+baselines max 8, floor 0.001), valid null-centered (|null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01), exceeding B-DOM-SIMILARITY and B-MARKOV-1 by >=0.05 bits on >=1 representation (R1 visible_text_hash or R2 a11y_tree_hash, isomorphic by construction). Mechanism: DOM_before carries information about L which biases S_next beyond what (URL, H_K=3, Action) captures; distinct from independent per-step observation noise already falsified (BC 0.004 bits, 0.025 bits, R2 0.003, p=1.0, now re-tested with >=6 variants to raise null_std). Recalibration K=24 corrects prior K=12 bias floor 0.1297>0.1 null_std 0.0094<0.01 borderline (producer notes K=24 mean 0.074 std 0.0104 would pass) converting borderline 0.688-bit signal (observed 0.8179 perm_mean 0.1297 BC 0.688 p 0.001 gap 0.688 over sim/markov, H 3.302, 24 strata) into confirmatory SURVIVES/FALSIFIED. Positive correlated synthetic must achieve BC>=0.30 p<0.01 null_std>0.01 |null_mean|<0.1; independent-noise replication with >=6 variants per state must show BC~0 (|BC|<0.05 p>0.10 null_std>0.01 |null_mean|<0.1) validating pipeline discrimination.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if on the correlated-state SPA dataset (primary, same construction as parent) for BOTH R1 visible_text_hash and R2 a11y_tree_hash, bias-corrected CMI BC <=0.05 OR trajectory-grouped permutation p_bonf>=0.01 (Bonferroni max 8) OR BC - max(B-DOM-SIMILARITY BC_sim, B-MARKOV-1 BC_markov1) <0.05, while pipeline gates pass (valid null centering |null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01 on primary, positive correlated control BC>=0.30 p<0.01 null_std>0.01 |null_mean|<0.1, independent-noise control BC~0 with |BC|<0.05 p>0.10 null_std>0.01 |null_mean|<0.1). This falsifies correlated DOM_state predictive dynamics via hash representations on locally-hosted correlated-regime SPAs as constructed, bounded to tested 6-state FSM class and hash truncation, not global Web production. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if pipeline gates fail: positive correlated control BC<0.30 or p>=0.01 or null_std<=0.01 or |null_mean|>=0.1 (pipeline blind/ miscalibrated to constructed correlation), OR independent-noise control shows BC>=0.05 and p<0.10 with valid null (pipeline confounded, cannot distinguish correlation from independence), OR any qualifying null degenerate (null_std<=0.01 or |null_mean|>=0.1 indicating bias floor miscentering) on BOTH R1 and R2, OR preprocessing fit on test, OR site identity leakage, OR resampling unit not trajectory_id. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST only if EXISTS R with BC_R>0.05 p_bonf_R<0.01 |null_mean_R|<0.1 null_std_R>0.01 and gap_R>=0.05 with all gates passing.
baselines: B-DOM-SIMILARITY (mandatory ordinary-similarity null): TF-IDF cosine k=5 over DOM visible_text (R1) and a11y text (R2) fit on TRAIN trajectories only (70/30 split by trajectory_id), predicting S_next via nearest-neighbor without stratification; compute BC_sim = I(S_next; NN_DOM_pred | URL, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) via same Bayesian DM K=24 alpha=1/K; primary must exceed B-DOM-SIMILARITY by >=0.05 bits to claim beyond-memory beyond ordinary similarity (director mandate).

B-MARKOV-1 (strong first-order Markov null): P(S_next | URL_before, Action_leakageFree) MLE on TRAIN grouped by trajectory_id, predicting without DOM; compute BC_markov1 via same Bayesian DM K=24; primary BC must exceed this by >=0.05 bits. Tests whether DOM adds beyond order-1 Markov.

B-MARKOV-K3 (history memory null): P(S_next | URL_before, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) majority vote stratified baseline, same as prior factorization; reports history-only accuracy and BC_hist; used to compute gap BC - BC_hist and to verify H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 ceiling not mathematically forced.

B-SHUFFLE-GROUPED (trajectory-grouped permutation null): 1000 within-strata shuffles of DOM_before labels grouped by trajectory_id seed 42, yielding null distribution mean/std/p; valid null_std>0.01 required; same as null_control but reported as baseline.
B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY: exact (URL, H_K=3, Action)->S_next memorization from TRAIN; reports memorization ratio and ceiling; not gating but leakage diagnostic.
B-SITE-LEAKAGE-DIAGNOSTIC: action_with_href vs leakageFree BC gap; leakageFree used for valid inference; reports inflation if href leaks.
positive_control: Synthetic correlated-state chain (deterministic seeds PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy 42): 6-state FSM states 0-5 partitioned into latent regimes L in {A,B} where L persists per trajectory (50 trajectories x 40 steps =2000 transitions, N=1999 analyzed) OR optionally per 15-step regime with P(flip)=0.07 documented but primary per-trajectory; transition matrix P(S_next | S_current, Action, L) differs by regime (L=A favors S_next in {0,1,2} basin, L=B favors {3,4,5} with p_stay 0.70 vs 0.30 cross), and DOM_before = SHA256(str(L)||str(S_current)||variant_mod) where variant_mod = step%3 ensures 3 DOM hashes per (S,L) but L uniquely recoverable from DOM hash family (36 hashes total, |R|/N 0.018); URL_before = hash fragment #/state_{S_current}; Action = leakageFree (primitive+target_sig, never href). Theoretical I(S_next;DOM|C) >=0.40 bits (binary L * transition difference). Must achieve BC>=0.30 Bonferroni p<0.01 null_std>0.01 |null_mean|<0.1 on R1 or R2 with same pipeline (Bayesian DM K=24 alpha=1/K N=1999, 1000 grouped perms, strata C=(URL_before_normalized, H_K=3 actions)). Failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline blind/miscalibrated (cannot detect constructed correlation). Construction frozen exactly in generate_correlated.py; any outcome-informed change is EXPLORATORY. Note parent K=12 gave BC 0.688 p 0.001 but null_mean 0.1297>0.1 null_std 0.0094<0.01 borderline; K=24 recalibration expected mean 0.074 std 0.0104 passing.
null_control: Three nulls required: (1) Independent-noise replication RECALIBRATED: reuse independent-noise construction but with >=6 variants per state (variant_mod = rng.choice(6) seeded per step, independent of L/S_next, same 6-state FSM without L bias, DOM variant independent of S_next, 50x40=2000 transitions N=1999) to raise null_std from prior 0.0046 to >0.01 as per audit required_fix; run identical Bayesian DM K=24 N=1999 trajectory-grouped permutation 1000 perms seed 42 on that dataset; must show BC~0 (|BC|<0.05) with p>0.10 and null_std>0.01 and |null_mean|<0.1 on R1/R2 (replicates prior falsification 0.004 bits but with valid variance). If independent-noise shows BC>=0.05 p<0.01 with valid null, pipeline confounded => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. (2) Trajectory-grouped permutation null on correlated dataset: within-strata shuffle of DOM_before labels grouped by trajectory_id (1000 perms seed 42) yielding null_mean/std/p; valid centering requires |null_mean|<0.1 (bias floor <0.1 bits, tightening from Laplace 0.3056 floor) and null_std>0.01 (non-degenerate) and p for null datasets >0.10; degenerate null_std<=0.01 or |null_mean|>=0.1 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that representation, not falsification, per G4. (3) IID synthetic null (same marginal P(S) but i.i.d. S_next, seed 42) must show BC<=0.03 p>0.10 |null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01 (or BF nats<0). Both nulls executed as frozen with same K=24 alpha=1/K grouping and Dirichlet prior.
measurement_validity: Substrate: locally-hosted Express synthetic FSMs only, no external production SPAs, no Gate0 title>=2/H>0.2 gating, no BrowserGym/WebShop manifests required, no network I/O beyond localhost. Primary dataset: correlated-state SPA (2000 transitions, 50 trajectories x40 steps, seed 42) as in positive_control with H(S_next|C) ceiling verified >0.3 bits after stratification (so CMI not forced 0). Secondary datasets: independent-noise replication RECALIBRATED with >=6 variants per state (2000 transitions, per-step independent DOM variant) and i.i.d. synthetic null (same marginal, i.i.d. S_next, seed 42). All stdlib only, no browser automation.

State S_next operational: S_next = SHA256(normalize(URL_after)||'|'||normalize(title_after)) where normalize(URL)=lowercase, strip query ?session=/?token=, preserve SPA hash fragment #/, strip trailing slash; normalize(title)=trim lowercased truncated 200 chars (constant title allowed). Report S_URLonly sensitivity. S_next distinct timestep from DOM_before (no post-state leak); DOM_before from step t, S_next from t+1.

Action A_leakageFree operational: A=(primitive, target_sig) primitive in {click, fill, navigate, select, submit, hover} target_sig=role+name+testId+aria-label (never href/URL/src); link target_href never enters A. Diagnostic A_leaky computed only for leakage gap.

History H_K=3 operational: H_K=(A_{t-2},A_{t-1},A_t, S_{t-2},S_{t-1},S_t) last 3 steps; strata key C=(URL_before_normalized, H_K_actions) where URL_before_normalized is URL_only without title to avoid state leakage into condition. Require strata_count>=5 unique C with >=3 per stratum for non-degenerate CMI; singleton_SA_rate<70%; report H(S_next|C) ceiling and strata distribution. If H=0 at K=3, CMI forced 0 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID environment ceiling, not falsification.

DOM_before representations tested independently: R1 visible_text_hash=SHA256(visibleText[0:5000] innerText), R2 a11y_tree_hash=SHA256(serialized AX tree role/name/value up to 5k chars), R3 multi_feature_hash=SHA256(R1||R2) exploratory, R4 numeric_structural element_count/tree_depth/interactive_density/form_count exploratory. Raw observables preserved (dom_bytes, a11y_bytes) with truncation documented; hash collision loss disclosed. Primary requires R1 or R2.

Estimator: Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial RECALIBRATED K=24 alpha=1/K N=1999 seed 42 (up from K=12) with bias correction via grouped permutation mean subtraction (BC = observed CMI - mean(permuted CMI)); also report plug-in for diagnostic but decision uses Bayesian BC. K=24 fixed per director mandate (alternative N~4000 at K=12 exploratory if K=24 borderline). Closed-form Gamma marginal likelihood, same as parent but K changed. Document recalibration rationale (audit required_fix mean 0.1297->0.074 std 0.0094->0.0104).

Permutation: 1000 trajectory-grouped shuffles of DOM_before labels within each C stratum, preserving per-trajectory DOM frequencies and marginals, grouped by trajectory_id seed 42; null distribution yields null_mean/std/p_raw/p_bonf; resampling unit = trajectory_id, not transition; no Gaussian jitter; report null_mean, null_std, p_raw, p_bonf = min(1,p_raw*n_tests) where n_tests = n_R * (1 primary +2 baselines) max 8. Bonferroni over R1/R2 x primary+baselines. Valid centering |null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01 required; degenerate => MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Split integrity: TF-IDF vocab for B-DOM-SIMILARITY and transition counts for B-MARKOV fit on TRAIN trajectories only (70/30 split by trajectory_id, grouped); holdout test used only for accuracy gaps; site identity never feature; leakage check performed; filter uses only URL_before_normalized without title.

Sampling integrity: policy documented (deterministic FSM with latent L per trajectory, 50 trajectories x40 steps, uniform action sampling among primitives); determinism via PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy seed 42; Python hash() never used as seed; trajectory_id is resampling unit; per-trajectory vs per-15-step regime documented.

Uncertainty integrity: resampling unit = trajectory_id; correlated transitions within trajectory not treated as independent; no Gaussian jitter bootstrap; report 95% CI via grouped permutation percentiles (2.5th/97.5th) not Gaussian; Cohen d = BC/null_std where null_std>0.01; report per-strata distribution.

Representation integrity: raw observables preserved or losses documented; derived hashes document truncation (5k) and collision; result must not be tautological: report MI(DOM_before; Action) to test action->DOM tautology (require <0.10 bits or gap over B-ACTION-FREQ); also require BC not explained by action frequency alone.

Gate0 not required: title variation and H>0.2 NOT gating; this experiment hosts its own correlated FSM so substrate_available by construction, avoiding prior Q=0 0.0 dom_bytes trap and 0/5-0/3 Gate0 MEASUREMENT_INVALID on TodoMVC/WebShop. Production BrowserGym WebShop DOM-bearing trajectories optional for generalization, not gating.

Auditability: all raw transitions, hashes, strata tables, permutation distributions, code paths committed with sha256 in provenance.json; execution re-executable from frozen commit yielding byte-identical raw_results.json aside from elapsed; freeze hashes verified before execution; seeds deterministic.
decision_rule: Gated execution in order, any triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID and prevents primary evaluation: G1 positive correlated control fails if BC<0.30 OR p_raw>=0.01 OR null_std<=0.01 OR |null_mean|>=0.1 => pipeline_blind_or_miscalibrated (prevents false negative even though prior K=12 gave BC 0.688 p 0.001, borderline on mean/std). G2 independent-noise replication shows BC>=0.05 and p<0.10 with valid null (|null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01) => pipeline_confounds (cannot distinguish correlation from independent noise; note prior K=12 independent BC -0.005 p 0.865 not confounded but degenerate std 0.0046; recalibrated >=6 variants must achieve std>0.01 while staying |BC|<0.05). G3 i.i.d. null BC>0.03 and p<0.10 with valid null => null miscentered. G4 primary null degenerate on BOTH R1 and R2 (null_std<=0.01 OR |null_mean|>=0.1) => null_degenerate (borderline parent 0.1297>0.1 0.0094<0.01 on both, but K=24 expected 0.074/0.0104 passing). If any G fails, verdict = MEASUREMENT_INVALID, publish gate_table, do not evaluate primary. Else primary: for each R in {R1,R2}, compute BC_R, p_bonf_R (=min(1,p_raw* n_tests) n_tests<=8, floor 0.001 at 1000 perms, alpha 0.01), null_mean_R, null_std_R, BC_sim_R, BC_markov1_R, gap_R = BC_R - max(BC_sim_R, BC_markov1_R), Cohen d_R=BC_R/null_std_R, 95% CI via permutation percentiles, H(S_next|C), strata stats, |R|/N, MI(DOM;Action). Define sig(R)=1 if BC_R>0.05 AND p_bonf_R<0.01 AND |null_mean_R|<0.1 AND null_std_R>0.01 AND gap_R>=0.05. If EXISTS R with sig(R)==1 => SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST — correlated DOM_before carries predictive information beyond (URL, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) and beyond ordinary similarity/Markov baselines on locally-hosted correlated-regime SPA via R1 or R2, bounded to tested 6-state FSM class and hash truncation, providing first falsifiable beyond-memory dynamics without Gate0. If FORALL R, BC_R<=0.05 OR p_bonf_R>=0.01 OR gap_R<0.05 while gates pass => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING — hash-DOM does not carry predictive information beyond memory/similarity even with constructed session-correlated non-determinism via Bayesian K=24 pipeline, bounded to hash-based DOM and tested K/alpha/pipeline. Sensitivity (nosmooth, S_URLonly, R3/R4, H_K=2/4, per-15-step regime, N~4000) not gating.
product_consequence_positive: SURVIVES with valid null centering (|null_mean|<0.1 null_std>0.01) converts borderline 0.688-bit signal into confirmatory beyond-memory correlated dynamics via hash DOM_before (R1 or R2) on locally-hosted session-regime SPAs via Bayesian DM K=24 trajectory-grouped permutation, gap >=0.05 over B-DOM-SIMILARITY (TF-IDF k5 0.0) and B-MARKOV-1 (0.0) while independent-noise remains BC~0 (|BC|<0.05 p>0.10 null_std>0.01) and iid BC<=0.03. First validated correlated-DOM dynamics without Gate0 production SPAs, expanding C-WEB-DYNAMICS ceiling beyond synthetic 2D TV/KDE blind spots and beyond independent-noise 0.004/0.025-bit falsifications. Product: distill DOM hash regime detectors as mechanism preconditions and exploration priors (regime-aware retrieval grouped by latent L, barrier guards for session shifts, freshness sentinel for DOM_before distribution change) into kernel resolve; prioritize BrowserGym collection on session-correlated sites (auth/cart/personalization) where latent regimes amplify; measure delta-repair cost when session shifts and cross-site holdout transfer of regime detector. No generic promotion until transfer validated.

Combined with prior independent per-step noise falsification (0.004 bits) and deterministic SPA 0.0 replication, this closes both independent-noise and correlated-regime hash-DOM factorization on tested 6-state FSMs. SPIDER must NOT invest in hash-DOM regime detectors as mechanical priors; physics lane should PARK correlated-DOM program on hash truncation and consider richer visual/computed-style DOM, interaction event sequences, or true production SPA correlated latent regimes with larger state spaces and non-hash representations before further physics spend. Graph/Product continue on trajectory-memory/retrieval without physics prior; economics must be proven via retrieval/verification/repair amortization alone (e.g., C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY). This is bounded falsification at K=24 N=1999, not global closure of correlated dynamics with richer representations.
estimated_cost: Low: locally-hosted Express synthetic FSMs only (no browser, no LLM calls, no network I/O beyond localhost). Generation: 3 datasets x2000 transitions (~6000 total) with deterministic seeded RNG (PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy 42), SHA256 hashes. Analysis: Bayesian DM K=24 N=1999 with 1000 trajectory-grouped permutations x (1 primary +1 independent-recalibrated +1 iid) x 4 representations x 3 baselines = ~36k CMI fits, each Gamma closed-form <1ms; total <60 min CPU, <8 GB RAM, no GPU, <3h wall-clock deterministic seeds 42. Reuses validated pipeline from EXP-PHYSICS-35782523165 with only K changed 12->24 and independent variants 3->>=6.

Either valid SURVIVES (first beyond-memory correlated DOM dynamics via hash, product-usable regime detector, expands claim ceiling beyond 64 synthetic 2D and 3-state minimal SPA experiments and beyond pooled TV/KDE 61 blind spots) or valid FALSIFIED (closes correlated hash-DOM on this FSM class after independent already closed, forcing park) changes C-WEB-DYNAMICS claim and product decision without requiring new Gate0 production SPAs (which are 0/3 after exhaustive BrowserGym/CAP/Mind2Web enumeration and 0.0 dom_bytes on reused TodoMVC). MEASUREMENT_INVALID (positive control <0.30 or independent confounded or null degenerate) is also informative and refuses false negative, documenting remaining calibration gap. Marginal gain vastly exceeds another synthetic TV/KDE/DOM estimator tuning (9/10 frontier scaling failures rho ~0 CV>0.5) or another Gate0 CMI retry (0/2-0/3 failures on titles/entropy/leakage) or another BrowserGym harness run; per director comparative reasoning this is the only falsifiable beyond-memory program not requiring new Gate0 SPAs.
